name: Lead Generator - Remotive contracts (REVIEW BEFORE ACTIVATION)

nodes.name: Import into Laravel - set URL and credential

parameters.content:
## Paused connector — no real leads fetched yet
1. Verify current Remotive API terms, rate limits, attribution and private-dashboard/AI-processing permissions. This is NOT permission to scrape other websites.
2. Change permission gate to true only after review. Enable matching Laravel source config.
3. Set Laravel HTTPS import URL and HTTP Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <private token>.
4. Manual test first; check this workflow against your installed n8n version before publishing.
5. Candidate cadence: every six hours, one feed request per run, no aggressive retries. Adjust to current provider rules.
6. Filters: recent 30 days, explicit contract/freelance, relevant skills, max 30 newest per run. Not exhaustive: no pagination/cursor; new busy feeds may need a revised strategy.
7. Keep Remotive attribution and original links. No auto-contact and no AI calls on import.
8. Add redacted error alerts before production. Saving execution payloads is disabled for privacy.
